items.originalTitle: Red Bull admits frustrating F1 problem will not be fully fixed until 2027
detailZh: 红牛承认F1问题将在2027年才能完全解决
红牛车队负责人劳伦特·梅基斯承认，车队在比赛开始时遇到的问题将在2027年才能完全解决。
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛赛车，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和比赛分析。
红牛车队负责人劳伦特·梅基斯承认，车队在比赛开始时遇到的问题将在下一赛季才能得到完全解决。这是在伊萨克·哈德贾在美国大奖赛艰难起步后呼吁重新设计离合器之后。
红牛车手在奥斯汀赛事的起跑时从第三位跌至第五位，哈德杰将原因归咎于"离合器提前释放"。更糟糕的是，他和队友马克斯·维斯塔潘都遭遇了无线电故障，后者开玩笑说车队应该"开始使用手语交流"。
梅克斯被问及哈德杰是否正确，他说他的车队擅长解决复杂问题，但不擅长解决"愚蠢的事情"。
他表示，伊萨克所说的话中有些是真实的，意思是我们都对连续两场比赛中无线电故障的困扰感到沮丧。"这使每个人的生活都非常困难，所以确实，我们希望尽快解决这个问题，因为它应该是一个不需要消耗太多能量的项目，所以他在这方面是正确的。"
他说，起跑是一个更严重的问题。
“起跑是一个稍微复杂的问题，意味着起跑表现几乎涉及到公司的所有部门，可能除了空气动力学。它是引擎，是变速箱，是离合器，是许多事情，而且我们从赛季开始就确实看到了，在起跑性能方面我们并不是标杆。”
他说，车队提高的节奏使得它的比赛起跑更加引人注目。
“你可能还记得我们年初起跑有多糟糕。我们仍然不是标杆。而且，是的，汽车在此期间有很大改进，并且更接近前方的竞争使得这种差距现在更加痛苦，因为周围的竞争非常激烈。”
但为了完全修复，车队粉丝将不得不等待。
“所以，关于你的观点，一方面，我对从现在到年底我们将继续缩小与竞争对手的差距充满信心，因为每一场比赛我们都在学习，每一场比赛我们都能找到缩小差距的小方法。另一方面，我也同样清楚，在赛季结束前，我们不会成为标杆，这需要一些重大的设计和硬件改动，而且这是明年我们才能看到的事情。”
在无线电问题上，法国人承认他们不明白问题根源在哪里。
“如果我们理解了，我们就会解决这个问题，所以我们不完全明白为什么我们会受到这些问题的困扰。当然，我必须承认，竞争者在我们的表现上做得更好，因为我们显然能听到每个人的无线电，而我们比我们希望的更努力地挣扎。”
detailEn: Red Bull admits frustrating F1 problem will not be fully fixed until 2027
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has admitted the team's race start problems will not be fully resolved until 2027
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has admitted that the issue the team has faced at the start of races won't be fixed until next season. This comes after Isack Hadjar called for the clutch to be redesigned following a difficult start to his United States Grand Prix.

The Red Bull driver dropped from third to fifth as the lights turned off at the start of the Austin race, with Hadjar blaming "clutch over delivery". To make matters worse, both he and team-mate Max Verstappen suffered from radio issues, with the latter joking that the team should "start communicating in sign language".
Mekies was asked whether Hadjar was right when he said his team was good at fixing complex issues, but not "silly things".

“I think there is some truth in what Isack is saying, meaning we are all frustrated to struggle for the second race in a row with the radio issues," he told the media. "It’s making everyone’s lives very difficult, so it is true that it’s something that we would like to fix quite quickly because it’s an item that should be working without using too much of our energy, so he’s right on that one.”
The starts, he said, are a more substantial problem.

“The start is a slightly more complex issue to solve, meaning that the start performance is going across pretty much all the departments of the company, probably except aerodynamic. It’s engine, it’s gearbox, it’s clutch, it’s many things, and we certainly have seen from the beginning of the season that we are not the benchmark in term of launch performance.”
He said the team’s improved pace has made its race starts more noticeable.

“And you may remember how bad our starts were at the beginning of the year. We are still not the benchmark. And yes, the fact that the car in the meantime improved a lot and is fighting closer to the front makes that deficit even more painful now because competition around us is very strong.”
But for a full fix, fans of the team will have to wait.

“So to your point, on one side I’m confident that we will continue to reduce the gap to the competition from now to the end of the year because every race we learn, every race we come up with small ways to close the gap. On the other side, I equally know that we will not be the benchmark before the end of the season, that it will require some significant design and hardware changes, and that this is something that we will see only next year.”
On the radio problems, the Frenchman admitted that they don't understand where the issue stems from.

“If we were understanding it we would have solved it, so we don’t fully understand why we are being hit by these issues. Certainly I have to admit that competition is doing a better job than us because we can obviously hear everyone’s radio, and we have been struggling more than what we would have liked to.”

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli reveals biggest mistakes of 2026 as Max Verstappen takes playful dig
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli, closing in on the title, listed the mistakes he wants to learn from this season, prompting a playful dig from Max Verstappen.
detailZh: 安东内利盘点2026赛季最大失误，维斯塔潘打趣回应
F1积分榜领跑者安东内利回顾了本赛季他希望从中吸取教训的失误
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
F1积分榜现任领跑者安东内利在接近年度冠军之际，列出了本赛季他希望从中吸取教训的失误，引来维斯塔潘的打趣回应。
这位梅赛德斯车手在美洲赛道从杆位赢得美国大奖赛，收获本赛季第九个大奖赛胜利。他在奥斯汀的胜利意味着，他如今只需在即将到来的墨西哥大奖赛中以第九名或更好的成绩完赛，就能锁定年度总冠军。
当被问及本赛季的高潮与低谷时，安东内利表示仍有工作要做。
“嗯，当然，到目前为止这个赛季是个不错的惊喜，”这位意大利车手在赛后新闻发布会上解释道。“当然，赛季还没有结束。还有几场比赛，我只想好好表现，仍然努力争取胜利。
“能以高光表现收官会很好。但回看这个赛季，确实还有需要改进的地方，需要在某些情况下调整心态，或者改变我处理一些场景的方式。
"所以，可以肯定的是，在赛季结束时，我会有更多时间回顾事情：哪些做得好，哪些本可以更好。但到目前为止，这是一个非常稳定的赛季，我们会努力保持到最后一刻。"
当被追问指的是哪些情况时，安东内利补充道："首先，澳大利亚第三节练习，那个失误。日本，我在起步时执行得很糟。然后迈阿密也是，冲刺赛，因为赛道限制白白丢掉了积分。是的，赛道限制对我来说是更大的问题。"
四届冠军维斯塔潘如今已在数学上退出冠军争夺，他开玩笑说安东内利的赛道限制违规："你今天只有一次，"安东内利回应道："是的，只有一次！今天不错。但可以肯定的是，在这类情况下，以及在一些排位赛节次中，我就是没有带着正确的心态进入。所以，是的，就是要确保我改进这些。"
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli reveals biggest mistakes of 2026 as Max Verstappen takes playful dig
Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli reflected on the mistakes he wants to learn from this season
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Current Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli has listed the mistakes he wants to learn from this season as he closes in on the title, prompting a playful dig from Max Verstappen.

The Mercedes driver won the United States Grand Prix at the Circuit of the Americas from pole position, claiming his ninth grand prix victory of the season. His win in Austin means he can now clinch the championship with a top-nine finish at the upcoming Mexican Grand Prix.
Asked about the highs and lows of his campaign, Antonelli said there is still work to be done.

"Well, for sure, it's been a good surprise this season so far," the Italian explained during the post-race press conference. "Of course, it's still not over. There are still a few races where I just want to do well and still try to fight for wins.

"It would be good to finish on a high. But definitely looking back at the season, there are still things to work on and improve on the mindset in certain situations or the way I handle a few scenarios.

"So, for sure, at the end of the season, I will have more time to look back at things: what went well, what could have been better. But it's been a very consistent season so far, and we'll try to keep it that way until the end."

Pressed on which situations he was referring to, Antonelli added: "First of all, Australia FP3, the mistake. Japan, I had a bad execution at the start. Then Miami as well, the sprint race, just throwing away points as well with track limits. Yeah, track limits has been the bigger thing for me."

Four-time champion Verstappen, who is now mathematically out of the championship fight, joked about Antonelli's track limits infringement: "You had only one [today]," to which Antonelli responded: "Yeah, only one! It was good today. But definitely, in these kinds of situations, and also in some of the qualifying sessions, I just didn't go in with the right mindset. So, yeah, just making sure I improve those."
keyPointsZh: 安东内利在美洲赛道从杆位赢下美国大奖赛，这是本赛季第九场分站胜利。
凭借奥斯汀站的胜利，他如今已具备提前锁定年度冠军的条件。
keyPointsEn: Antonelli won the United States Grand Prix at the Circuit of the Americas from pole position, his ninth grand prix victory of the season.
His win in Austin means he can now clinch the title.

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris delivers harsh reality check as McLaren's F1 struggles continue
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯直言不讳，麦凯轮的F1赛车困境持续
兰多·诺里斯承认，麦凯轮现在在一级方程式赛车中仅排名第四快
对于麦凯轮的粉丝来说，来自沃金克的新闻如同苦瓜，最新消息涉及车手、赛车、团队策略以及每个周末的赛事
现任冠军兰多·诺里斯承认，他在美国大奖赛中获得第五名后，麦凯轮已经从冠军领跑者滑落到一级方程式赛车中第四快的车队，这是‘相当明显’的
他在这场美洲赛车场的比赛中，落后于基米·安东内利、查尔斯·勒克莱尔、马克斯·维斯塔潘和刘易斯·汉密尔顿，队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在第七位，落后他两个位置。虽然这对一支一年前还在为冠军而战的团队来说是一个令人失望的结果，但诺里斯确认升级正在发挥作用。
“是的，我只希望你能穿上一些东西，然后它变得神奇，你突然跑得很快，开始争夺领奖台。一切都在按计划进行，但你知道，所有的车队，法拉利带来了升级，所有的车队都在带来升级，所以它们正在交付。只是，我想，并不是在所有我们需要它们的地方，比如低速弯角，我们离我们需要的水平还差得很远。
“我们需要更多的后部和低速性能。这是我们长期存在的问题。这似乎非常难以解决。”
当被问及这使麦克拉伦成为第四快的车时，诺里斯迅速回答。
“是的，我觉得这很明显。”
没有足够的速度去争夺领奖台，麦凯轮车队采取了单停策略，希望虚拟安全车或安全车能够帮助到他们。
“是的，我们尝试了。我的意思是，我们在速度上并不占优势，所以我们不得不冒险一试，如果有任何虚拟安全车或安全车，我们就有机会争夺一个好的领奖台位置。甚至大部分时间都有可能获得第二。我觉得今天的比赛很棒。我觉得速度很强。我觉得我已经从比赛中得到了所有我能得到的，所以即使第五名听起来并不那么令人兴奋，我也必须感到高兴。”
这个策略让诺里斯在比赛后期使用了老化的轮胎，他在那里坚持了几圈才被已经停站两次的红牛车手韦斯塔潘超越。
“不可避免地，当他开启超车模式，而我不得不使用加速模式来防守时，他很容易就会超过我。所以他那样做了，然后当我轮胎磨损时，游戏就结束了，对其他人来说也很容易。”
迈凯轮也在比赛中更换了车手，诺里斯表示他整个周末都比皮亚斯特里快得多，所以更换车手是‘显然的事情’。”
这个结果对车队锦标赛有很大的影响。迈凯轮在奥斯汀以七分领先红牛进入第三名的争夺。现在，车队们将带着五轮剩余的积分离开奥斯汀。
detailEn: Lando Norris delivers harsh reality check as McLaren's F1 struggles continue
Lando Norris has conceded that McLaren is now only the fourth-fastest team in Formula 1
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

Reigning champion Lando Norris has admitted it's "pretty obvious" that McLaren has slipped from championship leaders to being the fourth-fastest team in Formula 1 after he finished fifth at the United States Grand Prix.

He finished the race behind Kimi Antonelli, Charles Leclerc, Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton at the Circuit of the Americas, with team-mate Oscar Piastri finishing two places behind him in seventh. While this is a disappointing result for a team that less than a year ago was fighting for titles, Norris confirmed that the upgrades are working.

“Yeah, I’m just hoping you put something on and it’s magical and you go a lot quicker and you’re fighting for a podium all of a sudden. Things are all working as they should, but you know, all the teams, Ferrari brought upgrades and all the teams are still bringing upgrades, so they’re delivering. Just not, I guess, just not really in all the places that we need them to, like the slow speed corners, we’re just nowhere near at the level we need to be.
"We need a lot more rear and slow speed. It’s been our issue for a long time now. It seems to be very hard to tackle.”
Asked if that made McLaren the fourth-quickest car, Norris was quick to answer.
“Yeah, I think it’s pretty obvious.”
Without the pace to fight at the front, McLaren gambled on a one-stop strategy, hoping a virtual safety car or safety car would play into its hands.

“Yeah, we tried. I mean, we were not there on pace or anything, so we had to give it a shot and if there’s any VSC or safety car, we were right in contention for a good podium. Even a P2 for a lot of it. I feel like it was a good race today. I feel like the pace was strong. I feel like I got everything out of it, so I have to be happy even though a P5 doesn’t sound amazing.”
The strategy left Norris on ageing hard tyres late in the race, where he held off Verstappen for several laps before the Red Bull driver, who had already stopped twice, found a way past.

“Inevitably as soon as he had Overtake [mode] and I had to use Boost [mode] to defend, he was going to come past quite easily. So he did that and as soon as I then have traffic on old tyres, then it’s kind of game over and it’s easy for everyone else.”
McLaren also swapped its drivers during the race, with Norris saying he had been “a lot quicker all weekend” than Piastri, so the swap was “just the obvious thing to do”.

The result has big implications in the constructors’ championship. McLaren arrived in Austin seven points ahead of Red Bull in the fight for third. The teams will now leave Austin level with five rounds remaining.
